The '''Alibata-Unyo advanced sensor system''' was a sensor system developed by [[Alibata-Unyo]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The system included custom software and hardware that allowed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to temporarily boost its sensor range, and targeting telemetry that could detect cloaked ships.
